title: Petal vesting v1
description: vesting/v1 (12 Nov): a token's vesting schedules, one allocation each, as whoever found them wrote them, kept by the token's map. Each allocation names the account its locked tokens sit in, who can claim them, its total, how it releases (lumps at a moment, streams from one moment to another in steps or continuously; the amounts add up to the total), what was withdrawn when read, and how it's known: verified (read on chain), published (the project's own table) or inferred (from the same pattern as one read on chain). From it, at a reading's date, each petal that holds allocations is cut into unlocked, next unlock and later. One per map, read again to refresh.

about.description: the token's map, by its address (its card's id): <chain>:<token>

decimals.description: as its contract or mint says

token.description: the token the allocations are in

lump.description: all of the amount at one moment: a cliff, a lump

stream.description: the amount from one moment to another: in equal steps every `every` seconds, the first at from + every and the last at `to`; or, with every null, continuously

name.description: the allocation's name, as its source gives it

holder.description: the account its locked tokens sit in: a lock program's account, a stream, a vesting contract

beneficiary.description: who can claim them, or null where not known

schedule.description: how it releases; the amounts add up to its total

released.description: what was withdrawn from it, as read, or null where not read

known.description: verified: read on chain; published: the project's own table; inferred: from the same pattern as one read on chain

how.description: how it's known, in a sentence

ref.description: a transaction, an account, a page
